charge:
EEOC FORM 5 (11/09)
CHARGE OF DISCRIMINATION
Charge No. 410-2026-10000
EEOC Office: Atlanta District Office
Charging Party: Reese Underwood
City/State: Phoenix, AZ
Respondent: Northgate Industries Corp.
DISCRIMINATION BASED ON: Color, Sex
DATE(S) DISCRIMINATION TOOK PLACE: Earliest 12/25/2025 Latest 07/09/2026
THE PARTICULARS ARE:
1. I was employed by Northgate Industries Corp beginning before December 25, 2025. The conduct
described below began on or about December 25, 2025 and continued through July 09, 2026.
2. I was issued written discipline for conduct that similarly situated employees engaged in
without consequence.
3. I requested a reasonable accommodation and my request was denied without discussion.
4. I believe I have been discriminated against because of my color and sex, in violation of
applicable federal law.
